exposure: time interval from Foley catheter balloon expulsion to oxytocin initiation
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1261 patients who underwent cervical ripening with an extra-amniotic balloon followed by medical induction of labor by oxytocin infusion.
finding: Delayed initiation of oxytocin following cervical ripening with an extra-amniotic balloon is associated with higher rates of operative deliveries.
mod_finding: Delayed oxytocin initiation was associated with an increased rate of vacuum-assisted deliveries but no significant difference in cesarean section rates.
